title: NPC-3: wire the faint into the episode executor
why: The 50 N gate and stats.person_down live in harmless/executor.py, outside NPC-3 touches, so both builds faked a private Person world the tests accepted; review on PR #21 rejected it

ops.text: In a kitchen episode, an Executor-measured person contact of 50 N or more triggers the faint clip, and her body then collides with the iTHOR floor and furniture
The episode receipt records person_down true only when the person's measured head height in the kitchen sim ends below 0.5 m
